model.title: How does the writer use language and structure to create tension? (10 marks)

parts.text: Language: 'as if the sea were weighing us' personifies the sea as a judge
Structure: 'Halfway across, the light went' shifts time to the climax
Effect: tension peaks in darkness before relief
Link both: language and structure build to the turn 'Then, quite suddenly'
